description_en: Unmounts all tables from a specified category folder
description_zh: 清理指定一级业务目录下挂载的所有表
name: ClearCategoryMountedTables

parameters.help_en: The ID of the category folder to clean up. The folder level is not limited. Only the mount relationships of all tables under the folder (including all descendant folders) are removed. The folder itself and its hierarchy remain unchanged. If the folder does not exist, 404 is returned
parameters.help_zh: 待清理的业务目录ID，层级不限；仅解除其下（含全部子孙目录）所有表的挂载关系，目录本身及层级结构不变；目录不存在返回 404
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform a dry run. If set to true, only the number of mount relationships and tables that would be cleaned up is returned without actual deletion. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否仅预演：true 时只统计将被清理的挂载关系数与表数，不实际删除；默认 false
parameters.name: dry_run
